limitations: The near-p=4 upper and lower estimates differ by a logarithmic factor, and neither is claimed optimal for the true minimum counterexample dimension. The large-p O(p) upper bound may be far from optimal. The Hadamard-order transfer applies to Xiong's specific two-block construction. Chalmers' separate p=5 construction can be smaller at individual exponents. The motivating all-p>4 preprint is very recent, so unindexed parallel work remains possible.
record_title: Hadamard-order amplification and onset bounds for Kusner counterexamples
